questions.question: At which ground did Monique Ferreira record their career-best innings (111*, List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at St George's Park, against Iinyathi on 2024/11/16.

questions.question: In head-to-head List A meetings, who has the edge, Cobras or Titans?
At Newlands Stadium, who holds the record for 'Most Wickets' (List A)?
Warriors set a database record (14/15 season, List A) with a value of 377. Which record is it?
options: Lowest Team Total (all out or completed innings)
questions.explanation: It's the record for 'Highest Team Total', held by Warriors.

questions.question: At which ground did Knights record their 'Largest Win by Runs' (T20)?
questions.explanation: It was at Bloemfontein Oval — largest win by runs of 136, against Kei on 2018/11/25.

questions.question: Sune Luus is the only player to ever score 150 runs and take 4 wickets in the same match. Against which opposition did she achieve it, in November 2013?
questions.explanation: Luus scored 150 and took 4 for 1 against Limpopo Lillies on 23 November 2013, the only time this double has ever been achieved.
